title: Toeplitz Matrix Check
description: A matrix is Toeplitz when every entry other than one in the first row or first column equals the entry immediately above and to its left. Given a rectangular integer matrix `matrix`, return whether it is Toeplitz. Input: `matrix`. Output: true or false.
hints: Check each cell using its row and column relationships.
Handle single-row, single-column, tie, and center-cell cases explicitly.
